verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents MCP client capability. The desktop app can install and run MCP connectors on the local machine or network, and Connectors let an Agent use a service or tool. A large MCP marketplace is also framed as a way to power Agents. The evidence only clearly covers local connectors in the desktop app, so the coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented support for adding remote or HTTP MCP servers in the web or self-hosted app, setup and configuration docs for tool invocation, and independent or hands-on confirmation that MCP tools work in agent runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Desktop can now install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or your local network.
